aggregation.retrieval.recall*: mean of per-family means, families pooled across repos (a repo counts by its number of families)
aggregation.retrieval.perRepoMean: mean over repos of each repo's family-mean (every repo weighs the same)
aggregation.retrieval.byCategory: mean of per-family means within the category, pooled across repos
aggregation.answers.*: mean of per-family means over answered questions, pooled across repos
aggregation.answers.perRepoMean: mean over answered repos of each repo's family-mean
aggregation.blocks.default/jev: mean over labeled nodes pooled across repos (tau/top-k on shared candidates: nodes where it is undefined, e.g. one shared block, are skipped); omittedRendered = sum over nodes of rendered blocks missing from the hand order; keptDropped = sum over nodes of hand-kept candidate blocks the order does not render
aggregation.blocks.perRepoMean: mean over repos of each repo's per-node mean
aggregation.claims.*: pooled claim rows across repos; rates over judged (= checked − unavailable), unavailableRate over checked
aggregation.spendUsd.*: sum over repos (jevReservationEquivalent = $0.003 per Jev request: claim checks + block planner)
aggregation.labels: items with status "rejected" are excluded from every score; draft and checked both count
aggregation.rateLimited: sum of live 429s across repos and stages (backed off + retried, never silently dropped)
aggregation.stageMs.*: sum of each repo's last-pass wall time (repos may have run in parallel)
